### DELIBERATELY IMPLAUSIBLE NUMBERS (M74) ###
Every figure below is a fixture value chosen so that it can never be mistaken for a real baseline.
docs/gate-baselines.md is the only place real gate numbers live; a fixture that looked like one
would be a second copy of a fact, which is the defect that file exists to end. The controls in
tests/Feature/Docs/GateBaselinesTest.php assert the guard's verdict, never these figures.
